prompt_short: Convert the Excel workbook back to JSON, applying my edits

assertions.text: Response runs or describes running excel_to_json.py
Response does NOT include --no-apply-edits (edits should be applied by default)
assertions.evidence: Command did not include --no-apply-edits; default mode applies visible edits
"Your edits have been applied and the JSON has been written to schema.json at the workspace root"
